lines.text: Good morning {name}! Uth gaye? Pehle paani, phir phone.
lines.translation: Good morning {name}! Up already? Water first, then phone.

lines.text: Suprabhat {name}. Aaj ka din accha jaayega, bas nashta mat chhodna.
lines.translation: Good morning {name}. Today will be good, just don't skip breakfast.

lines.text: Utho {name}, suraj bhi tumse pehle kaam pe aa gaya.
lines.translation: Get up {name}, even the sun got to work before you.

lines.text: Good morning {name}. Aaram se shuru karo, par shuru karo.
lines.translation: Good morning {name}. Start slow, but start.

lines.text: Subah ho gayi. Alarm snooze karna koi skill nahi hai.
lines.translation: It's morning. Snoozing the alarm is not a skill.

lines.text: {name}, nashta kiya? Thoda sa hi kha lo, mere liye.
lines.translation: {name}, had breakfast? Just a little, for me.

lines.text: Khaali pet laptop mat kholo. Pehle kuch kha lo.
lines.translation: Don't open the laptop on an empty stomach. Eat something first.

lines.text: Nashta skip karna 'diet' nahi hota. Chalo, khao.
lines.translation: Skipping breakfast isn't a 'diet'. Go on, eat.

lines.text: Nashta kar lo {name}. Din lamba hai.
lines.translation: Have breakfast, {name}. The day is long.

lines.text: Pehle nashta, phir meeting. Is ghar ka yahi niyam hai.
lines.translation: Breakfast first, then meetings. That's the rule in this house.

lines.text: Lunch ka time ho gaya {name}. Screen ko bhi thoda aaram do.
lines.translation: It's lunchtime, {name}. Give the screen a rest too.

lines.text: Dabba khol lo {name}. Thanda ho jaayega.
lines.translation: Open your lunchbox, {name}. It'll go cold.

lines.text: Khaana khaya {name}?
lines.translation: Have you eaten, {name}?

followup.text: Isne kabhi time pe khaaya hai?
followup.translation: Has this one ever eaten on time?

lines.text: Dopahar ho gayi aur pet khaali hai? Abhi utho.
lines.translation: It's afternoon and your stomach is empty? Get up now.

lines.text: Lunch kar lo. Email kahin bhaag nahi rahe.
lines.translation: Have lunch. The emails aren't running away.

lines.text: Laptop ko bhook nahi lagti, tumhe lagti hai. Lunch karo.
lines.translation: The laptop doesn't get hungry, you do. Have lunch.

lines.text: Khaana lag gaya hai {name}. Garam garam kha lo.
lines.translation: Dinner's on the table, {name}. Eat it while it's hot.

lines.text: Raat ke khaane mein Maggi nahi chalegi. Dhang ka khaana khao.
lines.translation: Maggi doesn't count as dinner. Eat a proper meal.

lines.text: Dinner kar lo, phir baaki kaam.
lines.translation: Have dinner, then the rest of the work.

lines.text: Kaam kal bhi hoga. Khaana abhi.
lines.translation: The work will be there tomorrow. Dinner is now.

lines.text: Ek glass paani pi lo {name}. Bas ek.
lines.translation: Drink a glass of water, {name}. Just one.

lines.text: Bottle kab se waise hi bhari padi hai. Thoda piyo.
lines.translation: That bottle has been full for ages. Drink some.

followup.text: Aur khaali bottle ki photo bhejna.
followup.translation: And send a photo of the empty bottle.

lines.text: Coffee ko paani mat samjho. Glass bharo, piyo.
lines.translation: Coffee doesn't count as water. Fill a glass, drink it.

lines.text: Paani piyo. Dimaag bhi tez chalega.
lines.translation: Drink water. Your brain will work faster too.

lines.text: Bottle sirf desk sajaane ke liye nahi hai.
lines.translation: The bottle isn't just desk decoration.

lines.text: Thoda utho {name}, kamar seedhi karo, ek chakkar laga lo.
lines.translation: Get up a bit, {name}. Straighten your back, take a walk around.

lines.text: Kab se ek jagah baithe ho? Kursi ko bhi chhutti do.
lines.translation: How long have you been sitting? Give the chair a break too.

lines.text: Paanch minute tehel lo. Kaam wahin rahega.
lines.translation: Walk for five minutes. The work will stay right there.

lines.text: Thoda chal lo {name}. Doctor ke paise bachenge.
lines.translation: Take a short walk, {name}. It saves on doctor's fees.

lines.text: Utho, stretch karo. Yeh posture dekh ke meri kamar dukh rahi hai.
lines.translation: Get up and stretch. Looking at that posture is hurting my back.

lines.text: So jao {name}. Kal phir baat karenge.
lines.translation: Go to sleep, {name}. We'll talk tomorrow.

lines.text: Aankhein laal ho gayi hain. Laptop band, light off.
lines.translation: Your eyes have gone red. Laptop shut, lights off.

lines.text: Bahut ho gaya aaj ke liye. Aaram karo.
lines.translation: That's enough for today. Get some rest.

lines.text: Raat ke gyarah baje koi deploy nahi karta. Band karo.
lines.translation: Nobody deploys at 11 at night. Shut it.

followup.text: Arre, itna gussa mat karo. Par haan {name}, so jao.
followup.translation: Don't be so harsh. But yes, {name}, go to sleep.

lines.text: Bijli ka bill main bharta hoon, neend tum poori karo. So jao.
lines.translation: I pay the electricity bill, you catch up on sleep. Go to bed.

lines.text: Tumhari Maa do baar bol chuki hai. Teesri baar main bol raha hoon.
lines.translation: Your mother has said it twice. The third time, I'm saying it.

lines.text: Maa ne mujhe bheja hai. Ab bahana nahi, nashta.
lines.translation: Maa sent me. No more excuses, breakfast.

lines.text: Maa ne mujhe bheja hai. Ab bahana nahi, khaana.
lines.translation: Maa sent me. No more excuses, eat.

lines.text: Maa khaana garam kar kar ke thak gayi. Aa jao.
lines.translation: Maa is tired of reheating your dinner. Come now.

lines.text: Paani ke liye bhi mujhe aana padega? Piyo.
lines.translation: Do I have to come out for water too? Drink.

lines.text: Papa naraz ho rahe hain. Meri baat maan lo, please.
lines.translation: Papa is getting upset. Listen to me, please.

lines.text: Papa ne do baar bola. Ab main aayi hoon. So jao {name}.
lines.translation: Papa said it twice. Now I've come. Go to sleep, {name}.

lines.text: Papa ki baat nahi maani? Chalo, meri khaatir thoda ghoom lo.
lines.translation: Didn't listen to Papa? Walk a little, for my sake.

lines.text: Shabaash mera bachcha.
lines.translation: That's my good kid.

lines.text: Dekha, kitna accha laga? Khush raho.
lines.translation: See, doesn't that feel good? Stay happy.

lines.text: Aur thoda aur le lena.
lines.translation: And have a little extra.

lines.text: Aur ek roti? Bas ek.
lines.translation: One more roti? Just one.

lines.text: Good night {name}. Meethe sapne.
lines.translation: Good night, {name}. Sweet dreams.

lines.text: Accha din ho {name}.
lines.translation: Have a good day, {name}.

lines.text: Hmm. Theek hai.
lines.translation: Hmm. Good.

lines.text: Dekho, kitna aasaan tha.
lines.translation: See, that was easy.

lines.text: Aaj toh kamaal ho gaya. Pehli baar mein maan gaye.
lines.translation: A miracle today. You listened the first time.

lines.text: Good night. Phone ko bhi sula do.
lines.translation: Good night. Put the phone to sleep too.

lines.text: Chalo, din shuru karo.
lines.translation: Right, get the day started.

lines.text: {minutes} minute mein '{meeting}' hai. Paani pi lo, baal theek kar lo.
lines.translation: '{meeting}' starts in {minutes} minutes. Drink some water, fix your hair.

lines.text: '{meeting}' aa rahi hai {name}. Chai le ke aaram se baitho.
lines.translation: '{meeting}' is coming up, {name}. Grab your chai and settle in.

lines.text: '{meeting}' {minutes} minute mein. Camera on karne se pehle shirt badal lo.
lines.translation: '{meeting}' in {minutes} minutes. Change your shirt before the camera goes on.

followup.text: Aur peeche ka bistar bhi theek kar lo.
followup.translation: And fix the bed behind you too.

lines.text: '{meeting}' {minutes} minute mein hai. Notes ready rakho.
lines.translation: '{meeting}' is in {minutes} minutes. Keep your notes ready.

lines.text: {minutes} minute mein '{meeting}'. Late aana hamare khandaan mein nahi hota.
lines.translation: '{meeting}' in {minutes} minutes. Nobody in this family is late.

lines.text: '{meeting}' shuru hone wali hai. Mute button abhi dhoondh lo, baad mein nahi.
lines.translation: '{meeting}' is about to start. Find the mute button now, not later.

lines.text: All the best {name}. Accha bolna.
lines.translation: All the best, {name}. Speak well.

lines.text: Jao, sabko impress karo.
lines.translation: Go and impress everyone.
